Title: Dragon Head
Writer: Minetaro Mochizuki, Masa Nakamura, Hiroshi Saitô
Actors: Satoshi Tsumabuki, Sayaka Kanda, Takayuki Yamada
Plot: A teenage boy wakes up and finds himself on a train. He vaguely remembers being on a class trip when something terrible happened, and he is one of the few survivors.
